title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) — Overview and history
body: Signature edition. Original Signature organizational framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Signature profile of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC): Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is the world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry, headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. TSMC manufactures chips designed by other companies — including Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, and Qualcomm — and leads the industry in advanced process nodes such as 5nm and 3nm. It is the most valuable company in Taiwan and a linchpin of the global technology supply chain.
